turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why did my son find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Hale. That's not an answer. Who decided to enter the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for acting against a student. So what else do you have, or is that it?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable." Okay. Your own procedure says software results don't establish a concern by themselves, and I have it printed. Again: what else do you have?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Your procedure says you speak to the student first and call me before any mark goes in. Nobody did either. Withdraw the zero, Hale.
I hope you understand my position.
"My position." Okay. Mine is that Owen has a zero nobody can justify and I wasn't called. Show me one document that isn't a percentage, or withdraw it.
